resources.string: The Bambu network plug-in is not connected on Android yet. This setting will become available with support for the corresponding Bambu features.
Android maintains one Kepler workspace. Concurrent editing of the shared model from multiple tasks is not supported yet.
Loading a complete 3MF project configuration is not supported yet. The app offers geometry import separately and preserves the original project file.
STEP import is not available on Android yet. Accuracy controls will become available with support for this format.
Printing with multiple materials is not supported yet. This setting will become available with multi-material projects.
Object cloning is not available yet. Automatic arrangement will be connected together with cloning.
This reset requires the connected-printer preset synchronization prompt. It does not clear cloud profiles.
Only the remembered dialog answer is reset. Models, profiles and backups are kept.
Stealth mode permits local connections and blocks cloud operations. Offline mode also blocks local requests.
Automatic built-in profile updates are not connected yet. Desktop release checks are available separately and do not replace application profiles.
Kepler handles STL, 3MF and OBJ through Android Open with and Share. Select a file to test. Android controls the persistent default application choice.
This level controls structured Java diagnostics. Device addresses, keys, tokens and server response bodies are excluded. The native engine logging level is not changed yet.
Replace the current model and its transforms with the backup?
Workspace restored. Open Workspace to view it.
Automatic synchronization sends user profiles to your cloud profile account when the app opens. Conflicts are kept for manual resolution.
